title: README.md:147-148 compression example stale: '60+ bytes'/'about 41 bytes'/'native-address' vs normative 52->23/37 Yggdrasil
description: Found during edge-cases codereview pass of bijq (delegated to kimi-k3). README.md Compression section says: 'Uncompressed: 60+ bytes (IPv6 + UDP + CoAP)' and 'Compressed: about 41 bytes for native-address traffic in the baseline'. Three defects: (1) uncompressed base is 52 bytes per normative spec/03-adaptation.md 5.3 (40 IPv6 + 8 UDP + 4 CoAP), not '60+'; (2) no rule compresses to 41 bytes — normative figures are 23 bytes (Rule 0 link-local) or 37 bytes (Rule 1 Yggdrasil); (3) 'native-address' is the rejected pre-settlement terminology — the settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision (spec/decisions.jsonl) rejects the LICHEN-native profile; sibling corrected line README.md:52 already says 'Yggdrasil'. Fix: rewrite the two bullets to 52-byte uncompressed base and 23/37-byte compressed with link-local/Yggdrasil terminology. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-bijq.
close_reason: Rewrote README.md Compression example bullets to normative figures: uncompressed 52 bytes of headers (IPv6+UDP+CoAP), compressed 23 bytes (link-local, Rule 0) or 37 bytes (Yggdrasil, Rule 1); removed rejected 'native-address' terminology. Landed in commit 15dc110de0 (bd auto-sync swept the 2-line diff; exactly the intended hunk). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases PASS — one outside finding: python/README.md:76 '60+ bytes to ~10 bytes' stale (verified stale on origin/main too), filed as new P3 schc bead ln6h. appendix-misc.md:38 observation already fixed on origin/main via b7z9.205, no bead.
